description: Create a professional noise complaint log document. The document must include: (1) Header with title 'Noise Disturbance Log - Unit 4B', your name 'Alex Martinez', and date range 'January 15 - February 4, 2025' with proper formatting, (2) Opening statement about noise from Unit 5B, (3) Incident log table with 5 columns (Date, Time, Duration, Type of Noise, Impact) and 8 incident rows with provided data, (4) Impact summary section with calculations (8 total incidents, 2.7 per week, 18 hours total sleep loss), (5) Professional closing request. Apply proper formatting throughout (bold headings, 1.5 line spacing, table borders).
